description: Columns view: a file with a very long name is not truncated, so the column fills the screen and navigation behaves oddly.
expected_report: In a folder with a ~200-character file name, clicking a subfolder in Columns view leaves the current column filling the window and the next column out of view; clicking another folder only scrolls the view; resizing the window truncates the name and fixes the layout. Expected: the truncated layout from the start.
difficulty: Horizontal scrolling of columns, very long text, the resize changes everything.
